title: Where the name Spirits of Rhythm came from
summary: The members were from St. Louis; under Ben Bernie they were the Sepia Nephews and then took the Spirits of Rhythm name.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: The name, the Spirits, was that the idea of the Spirit of St. Louis, and then the Spirits of Rhythm?
Yeah. Well, the rest of them was from
They had that name when they came to New York already.
Yeah. And when we went with Ben Burnie, we named our group the Ben Burnie Sepia Nephews.
Right. Well, then, when you took the name on, the Spirits of Rhythm, I mean that's a very -- it's a spiritual name.
I mean, the idea of a spirit, you know?
Yeah. Although we didn't play much of spiritual songs, you know.
Yeah. But there's different kinds of spirit, right?
Yeah, that's right. We just took that name, the Spirits of Rhythm, the Four Spirits of Rhythm, the Six Spirits of Rhythm, and that's as far as we went. Ben Burnie's Sepia Nephews.
